title_zh: 习近平：中美关系又站在新的历史起点上
title_en: Xi Jinping: China-U.S. Relations Stand at a New Historical Starting Point
summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，习近平和夫人彭丽媛在白宫出席美国总统特朗普和夫人梅拉尼娅举行的欢迎宴会，习近平发表致辞。
summary_en: On the evening of Sept. 24 local time, Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan attended a welcome banquet hosted by Donald and Melania Trump at the White House, where Xi delivered remarks.
